data.compiler_change: only disable observed gather_to_conv and fuse_channel_shuffle_split_concat_to_gather optimizer rules
retain v24 two Gather exclusions and additionally disable observed swap_slice_transpose

source_evidence.meaning: Concatenate local/global features, select token zero for the camera before the final patch feature normalization.
Flatten batch/views and run two full-width linears, then the t/quaternion/FOV output heads; only selected camera tokens enter the FCs.
Final dense bilinear resize explicitly uses align_corners=True.
Refinement resize preserves its original align_corners configuration.
Original interpolate, including align_corners=True; no alternate pixel-coordinate transform.

compiler_rule_evidence.text: D     swap_slice_transpose: remove node = ['/backbone/Gather_1_2sl', '/cam_dec/Reshape_output_0_tp'], add node = ['/cam_dec/Reshape_output_0_tp', '/backbone/Gather_1_2sl']

validation_required: Same input/output artifacts and all arrays against the original CPU and unchanged RKNN baseline
Actual profile shows selection before transpose or a small selected-token transpose
Separate normal timing and interleaved A/B calls; profile duration is not normal timing

dpt.restriction_explanation: The actual compiler/profile prove FLOAT16 bilinear align_corners placement on CPU. They do not prove that align_corners alone is the unsupported predicate.
dpt.unchanged_coordinate_map: u = j * (L_in - 1) / (L_out - 1) for these L_out > 1 shapes
dpt.future_expression_candidate: Two separable fixed-coordinate Gather + weighted-add passes with clamped floor/ceil indices; preserve align_corners. Not implemented or runtime validated.
risks: Different FP32/FP16 arithmetic order may change rounding
Gather may remain CPU and increase intermediate traffic
Do not replace align_corners with half_pixel, nearest, or integer repeat

limits: Local compiler rule experiment; no model or weight change
Removing one approximately 54 ms transpose cannot establish 20 Hz from the approximately 1.075 s two-view forward
DPT alternative graph is only a proposal; no deployment or numerical result claimed
Profile operator durations are SDK measurements from separate profile calls, not normal end-to-end latency

S=2 produces two poses from one overlapping pair; this is not two independent new observations or 20 Hz validation.
